invariants.rationale: This method returns early unless pointer == -1, so at method exit this must hold.
If touchIndependent && Gdx.input.isTouched() is true, the method returns early, so this must be false at normal exit.
If fromActor != null && fromActor.isDescendantOf(actor) is true, the method returns early, so at method exit either fromActor is null or not a descendant.
